stage: V3 implementation and development, no official-test efficacy claim
user_goal: Three datasets individually: mAP and Rank-1 gains of at least 2 percentage points over DeMo, with six missing-modality conditions covered; retain all metrics and negative results
development_protocol: Existing fixed identity-disjoint fit/dev split, public CLIP ViT-B/16 initialization, B64, 50 epochs, highest dev mAP selects checkpoint, earliest tie
input: Spatial patch grid with fixed symmetric complete low/mid/high FFT masks at .125/.25 cycles per patch, preserving spatial positions
modality_expert: Seven source sets; shared rank64 value/attention/output with seven queries and lightweight band query tags. Each structured query reads only its source set and band
frequency_expert: Three band-specific rank64 value/attention units share across modalities; a cross-band operation stays inside each modality. Source index retained until collaboration
base_path: Original full DeMo PIFE/HDM/ATMoE and original identity heads retained; corrections are small residual projections
conditions: One simultaneous query-condition round derived from independent U0/V0, with each updated expert still reading its own values. Lightweight conditions use FP32 after actual native AMP smoke and same-recipe diagnostic observed two zero LN gradients; main experts remain AMP
routing: 21-entry joint softmax a_S+c_b+psi(U,V), not 21 expert networks; independent marginal product when psi is removed
contribution: Four same-dimensional states, same detached current-batch base reference gallery and positive/negative indices; targets Delta_M_given_F, Delta_F_given_M, empirical interaction. Target stops gradient, predictor reads detached contexts. No EMA reference, information-theory claim, causal claim, or full mAP target
closed_states: Use independent M0/F0, absent predictor input zero, no conditional update, psi, or interaction projection. Shared original DeMo base remains in all states
inference: Normal full forward and predictor only; no controlled-state comparison or labels

matched_controls.plain_twins: Same actual parameter set, initial state, descriptor5632D, heads, losses and collaboration/calibration. Two attention experts access all full-frequency modalities/positions instead of source/band restrictions
matched_controls.ordinary_frequency: Same actual parameters and5632D. All extra matching capacity processes the bands inside the added ordinary frequency branch; original DeMo first5120D is unchanged at initialization and by fusion construction

missing: Zero normalized input is the existing benchmark interface. Availability makes invalid structured source sets ineligible and masks unavailable values; six actual cases tested. No modality-dropout training in this first V3 stage
M0_required: Three actual-data structural verifications plus ten separate three-update nativeAMP/reload smokes (nine main and MSVR contribution-off), on GPU0 only after previous RGBNT201 dual residual50 finishes; no reuse of M0 weights
development_queue: Ten fresh seed42 50epoch runs: three datasets x axis_collaboration/plain_twins/ordinary_frequency plus MSVR axis contribution-weight0. Jobs redistributed as2/2/2/4 across four cards to reduce waiting behind three long RGBNT100 runs; GPU3 gets three RGBNT201 runs then MSVR contribution-off. Each card waits its exact previous V2 exits and free GPU; no test scoring. M0 prerequisite root is axis_collaboration_v3_preflight_fp32, preserving original failed M0
efficacy_status: Unproven. V1 test failures and V2 development failures retained; this architecture must still establish all main and missing metrics with repeated seeds and integrity audit
